### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: I think you should try using Strengthen on all the garments first, then run the simulation again to see if the clipping still happens.If it’s still an issue, you can try setting Layer values for the pieces that are intersecting. Also, the underarm area in your pose looks very tight, you might want to slightly adjust the pose or increase the Collision Thickness to give the fabric more space to resolve properly.From your image, it also looks like the fabric might be a bit too soft, i think you could try switching to a stiffer fabric and see if that helps.

Comment 2: I don't see much detail in those two images. Better to share the project file with us through the contact us page.

It's just a bit time - consuming, but I still think it's a good challenge.

* * *

Now, let's take a look at my production process together.

![1e3c5947414e4339baa50af6c260b48c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/1e3c5947414e4339baa50af6c260b48c%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-09%20145559.png)First, I made her weapon, then created the movements and matched the weapon's state with the postures. After that, I could focus on making the clothing at ease.

![2a8d34afd822455d9e3931855cf1fe7e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/2a8d34afd822455d9e3931855cf1fe7e%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-12%20133420.png)![82897b783ebf4244bcd21df9dcb3b976](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/82897b783ebf4244bcd21df9dcb3b976%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-12%20124135.png)Based on my background in fashion, I first fully replicated the character's clothing. Using the default model's measurements, the clothing's structure, details, and fabric are all intact.

* * *

![aea2cf6274a8482886e89504ac03d33f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/aea2cf6274a8482886e89504ac03d33f%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-14%20100800.png)The trousers are relatively simple. The structure of the vest is actually quite interesting, and I made it according to my own understanding.

![950bfd1502694a3aa436882feb176c2d](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/950bfd1502694a3aa436882feb176c2d%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-12%20223034.png)Finally, I combined them together and then went on to complete the other details.

![7edce4e661be4b228660b197669c907a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/7edce4e661be4b228660b197669c907a%E9%92%9F%E6%97%A0%E8%89%B3%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2%E5%A5%97%E8%A3%85_F.png)![8d776e11bcfb4d46885d4da97a06ad72](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/8d776e11bcfb4d46885d4da97a06ad72%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-16%20152744.png)This is the complete A - pose effect.

* * *

Then I simulated the clothing on the model's pose that was determined at the beginning.

![c0f9d1dd50c9483fab066790f26e3903](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/c0f9d1dd50c9483fab066790f26e3903%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-16%20152302.png)![cd3c268f1e4247f88f390e3ebb5978e0](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/cd3c268f1e4247f88f390e3ebb5978e0%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-16%20124454.png)And that's it. The result is quite good. However, it really did require a great deal of patience to carry this out. Fortunately, the outcome is satisfying. At the same time, I've also identified many areas for improvement, and I hope to overcome them one by one in the future.

title: Marvelous Award Winner Interview  from Dream Sequence 3D Community Challenge
content:
## _Bringing Stylized Yokai to Life: An Interview with_[ _Samuel Onyina_](https://www.instagram.com/yaw_cg_md/) _, Marvelous Award Winner of_[ _Pwnisher’s "Dream Sequence" Challenge_](https://createwithclint.com/community-challenges/12)

* * *

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7VyjLLpJEWA?start=0

# **Software Used**

Blender – Modeling  
Marvelous Designer – Cloth Simulation & Animation  
Substance Painter – Texturing  
Cycles (Blender) – Lighting & Rendering

# **Artist Introduction**

My name is Samuel Yaw Ampofo Onyina. Professionally, I am a physician based in Ghana. Alongside my medical career, I operate as a hobbyist 3D generalist under the social media moniker, [yaw_cg_md](https://www.instagram.com/yaw_cg_md/). I focus on character design and animation workflows to build compelling, narrative-driven visuals.

# **Please introduce your project.**

This animation was my submission for the Dream Sequence 3D Community Challenge hosted by Pwnisher. The piece centers on a haunting, trance-like state, featuring a Yokai. The core objective was to build an atmosphere of eerie suspense.

# **The template for this contest was very open ended, what was your inspiration for your animation?**

My inspiration stems heavily from Japanese mythological Yokai and "Kabuki-noir" as well as the work of the popular Malaysian artist, Zeen Chin. I wanted to capture the unsettling nature of a Yokai wraith who transforms the men who murdered her into marionettes that she now has control over as a form of revenge. The flowing, traditional-style robes were chosen deliberately because the way fabric drags, billows, and responds to a slow, deliberate walk cycle inherently adds drama and a surreal quality to the composition.

# **Tell us how Marvelous Designer creates value in this project.**

Marvelous Designer is strictly necessary for grounding stylized characters in reality. In this project, the character wears a complex, multi-layered robe that interacts heavily with their limbs as they walk with outstretched arms. Hand-animating those folds or relying on standard 3D package cloth modifiers would not yield the necessary physical accuracy. I really did not have to do much to achieve the look I desired and it was genuinely a happy accident seeing how convincingly the sleeves slid down the Yokai’s arms. MD is such an amazing tool. I love it so much.

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=56eOkP9ouE0?start=0

# ![1c7e7ab2771c40c2aa8c2756cbe3c7a6](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/5ebaca44c6c94cf38e8bb9f50c3af911/images/1c7e7ab2771c40c2aa8c2756cbe3c7a6Yokai5.png)![1454501597984554968edb1e55d6485e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/5ebaca44c6c94cf38e8bb9f50c3af911/images/1454501597984554968edb1e55d6485eRender1.png)![6c18dcb620724aecbf572657a2857e8c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/5ebaca44c6c94cf38e8bb9f50c3af911/images/6c18dcb620724aecbf572657a2857e8cFinal0011.png)  
**What is your favorite feature or tool to use in Marvelous Designer?**

**Sewing** , the **animation Mode** and the **Alembic export pipeline** are my primary tools. The solver's ability to handle complex layered collisions without intersecting, especially on loose, flowing garments like the robe in this sequence saves hours of manual corrective sculpting. I also love the UV editor. Although rudimentary, at the moment, it streamlines my process considerably. I no longer have to worry about unwrapping in blender and it allows me to jump into texturing quickly. Love that.

# **For other users considering Marvelous Designer, do you have any advice or experience to share?**

Keep your workflow disciplined. Build your garments with a high particle distance initially to quickly block out the silhouette and test your sewing patterns. Only lower the particle distance to refine the micro-folds once you are ready for the final simulation cache. Additionally, ensure your base avatar's animation is completely clean and free of intersecting geometry before bringing it into Marvelous Designer; good cloth simulation relies entirely on clean collision data.

Also, don't forget that you can add extra detail in any sculpting program you’re comfortable in and bake the detail down into normal maps in substance 3d painter.
content_description: This web page showcases an in-depth interview with Samuel Onyina, exploring his award-winning 3D animation of a stylized Yokai created using Marvelous Designer and other software to achieve realistic cloth simulation and atmospheric storytelling.
